lines.text: AMC eight challenge! Think it's seventeen over one hundred twenty-eight? Nope!
lines.caption: AMC 8 challenge! Think it's 17/128? Nope!

lines.text: A fair coin is flipped eight times.
lines.caption: A fair coin is flipped 8 times.

lines.text: What's the chance the same side never comes up three times in a row?
lines.caption: What's the chance the same side never comes up 3 times in a row?

lines.text: Count the good strings, flip by flip. One flip has two. Two flips have four.
lines.caption: Count the good strings, flip by flip. One flip has 2. 2 flips have 4.

lines.text: A good string ends in a single or a double. So four plus two is six!
lines.caption: A good string ends in a single or a double. So 4 plus 2 is 6!

lines.text: Keep adding: ten, sixteen, twenty-six, forty-two, sixty-eight!
lines.caption: Keep adding: 10, 16, 26, 42, 68!

lines.text: Sixty-eight out of two hundred fifty-six. That's seventeen over sixty-four!
lines.caption: 68 out of 256. That's 17/64!

lines.text: Seventeen over one hundred twenty-eight was the trap.
lines.caption: 17/128 was the trap.

lines.text: Did you get seventeen over sixty-four? Tell me below!
lines.caption: Did you get 17/64? Tell me below!
